from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperRelationship(BaseModel):
    """Citation relationship information extracted from a single document."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being parsed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers cited within this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    relationships: list[PaperRelationship]
